ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface with a macro-level white-to-black pixel ratio exceeding 10:1 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black perimeter banding follows the entire trailing edge and distal leading edges. Distinct vertical black elliptical blob located in the medial-central region of the right lobe; small circular black spot located in the superior-central region of the left lobe; transverse black bands at the fluke-peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to ~12% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the boundary. A significant macro-scale indentation (tissue loss) is present on the right lobe's inner trailing edge adjacent to the median notch, spanning approximately 80-100 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature along the trailing edges, transitioning into slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular textural depressions (pockmarks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe. High-intensity white clusters (potential barnacle scars) concentrated along the outer distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel, dark curved linear markings (rake marks) situated in the superior-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular U-shaped notch/tissue amputation on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately lateral to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, vertically elongated black pigmentation mark on the right lobe resembling an exclamation point or the numeral '1'.
